claims.assertion: Swaruu X (Athena) calls congressional UFO disclosures staged and says officials release basic details gradually to gauge public reaction.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says public testimony is treated as evidence without substantive material support.

claims.assertion: Athena says UFO disclosure may distract the public or precede a false alien invasion, though that outcome is uncertain.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She allows the disclosure push could instead lose momentum.

claims.assertion: Athena says authorities seek to standardize information about extraterrestrials and regulate what others, including extraterrestrials, can say.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Robert summarizes this as narrative control, which Athena affirms.
